Dana Scully

I didn't know that either.

Sheriff Teller

Dana Scully

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Well, what are you looking for? Just because a forensic profile isn't cut and dry... Doesn't mean it's not true.

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder
